verdict.rationale: Firebase has no documented native webhook subscription. Cloud Functions can run code in response to Firebase and Google Cloud events, such as Authentication and Cloud Storage triggers, and also handle HTTPS requests. A user could write a function that forwards events to their own endpoint, so the story is only achievable through a custom-code workaround. Missing for 10: first-class outbound webhook configuration, documented event catalog for webhook delivery, delivery/retry/signing guarantees, and independent corroboration.
